title: More readable mobile footer
summary: Compacted the newsletter, clarified contact rows and expanded mobile navigation touch areas.

changes.detail: Mobile newsletter heading uses the available width; rounded inputs, improved spacing and consistent sans-serif typography.
Contact details appear in bordered rows with stacked labels; navigation uses full-width expandable rows and larger plus controls. Social links use outlined 44px touch targets.
Small screens get an icon-only help launcher to reduce obstruction; footer bottom spacing accounts for floating controls and device safe areas.
Newsletter success/error announcements and busy state for assistive technology.
